searchText: <@439032863904628745> <@857052906495017000> and others it was a good call, you convinced me that Merkle commitments are better. We could deal with vector commitments but it will require anyway a Merkle root or a hash to only push 32 bytes in the bid. Just a couple of comments before I forget. I believe the only things that can't be committed in the envelope are the beacon block root and the prev randao. I don't really remember about withdrawals but I think those are fine now. The randao is a problem cause it's part of the payload. Perhaps it could be delayed one block but I wouldn't be sure about that either, perhaps it's just fine to add it to every chunk

Just a couple of comments before I forget. I believe the only things that can't be committed in the envelope are the beacon block root and the prev randao. I don't really remember about withdrawals but I think those are fine now. The randao is a problem cause it's part of the payload. Perhaps it could be delayed one block but I wouldn't be sure about that either, perhaps it's just fine to add it to every chunk
